title: Imaging and Spectral Analysis of the Crystalline Lens Using the "HYPERLAF" Slit Lamp
official: Imaging and Spectral Analysis of the Crystalline Lens Using the "HYPERLAF" Slit Lamp
summary: Cataract is the leading cause of reversible blindness and the first surgery worldwide. It corresponds to the crystalline lens opacification. Nevertheless, its grading remains mostly subjective and the Lens Opacities Classification System dating back 1993, is not used in daily practice and has not been revisited since. The HYPERLAF device developed by the start-up HYPEREYE is a modified slit lamp which combines imaging and spectral analysis, providing two quantitative objective scores: OPAK (opacity) and COLOR (spectral analysis). It is a non-CE marked prototype with non-invasive imaging methods.

interventions.name: Non-contact observation of the crystalline lens nucleus

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria :

* Patients enrolled in or eligible for a social security program
* Age 18 or older
* Patients with cataracts. In cases of bilateral cataracts, both eyes will be photographed and analyzed.
* Patient who has already received an instillation of 0.5% mydriaticum (tropicamide) and 10% neosynephrine (Théa Laboratories, Clermont-Ferrand, France) eye drops to dilate the pupil of the eye to be photographed (or both eyes).
* Signature of the consent form

Exclusion Criteria :

* Severe blepharospasm making the examination impossible.
* Poor or absent pupil dilation: patient with an allergy or intolerance to the eye drops used for pupil dilation; refusal of pupil dilation during the eye examination.
* Pregnant or breastfeeding patient
* person under legal guardianship
sponsor: Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Saint Etienne
